verdict.expected_speedup: near-linear with core count (4–16×) on multicore CPU; 50–200× via cuBLAS on GPU at larger N
verdict.justification: The (i,j) output elements are fully independent, making the kernel embarrassingly parallel with zero inter-thread communication; OpenMP collapse(2) over the outer loops plus cache-blocking delivers near-linear CPU scaling at N=256. MPI is a poor fit because inter-process communication cost exceeds the ~33M-FLOP workload at this problem size. For maximum performance, delegating to a tuned BLAS (MKL/OpenBLAS) is preferred over hand-written parallelism.
